$comment: Build-channel membership for non-production code areas. Each area under src/nonproduction/<area>/ lists the channels whose bundles INCLUDE its real implementation; every other channel gets the area's index.stub.ts and none of its sources reach the bundle or VSIX. Channels: development, internal, insiders, stable. See src/nonproduction/README.md.

sdkLanguageModels.description: Direct Anthropic/OpenAI/xAI SDK language-model providers used for internal model testing. Stable ships Copilot-based models only; the direct-API hooks require separate security/compliance review before any external release.
